```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = TRUE, warning = TRUE)
source("00_setup.R")
library(smplot2)
```

Phenotype and variant score distributions, ESTABLISHED vs NON-ESTABLISHED
genes. Needs the tables written by `02_read_filter_save.Rmd`.

## Data

```{r data}
scores_long <- read_all_vars() %>%
  pivot_longer(c(EXOMISER_GENE_PHENO_SCORE, EXOMISER_VARIANT_SCORE),
               names_to = "SCORE", values_to = "VALUE") %>%
  mutate(SCORE = recode(SCORE,
                        EXOMISER_GENE_PHENO_SCORE = "PHENOTYPE SCORE",
                        EXOMISER_VARIANT_SCORE    = "VARIANT SCORE"))

# Score cutoffs: candidate search (green) and benchmarking (grey)
candidate_cutoffs <- tibble(SCORE  = c("PHENOTYPE SCORE", "VARIANT SCORE"),
                            CUTOFF = c(pheno_score_cutoff_candidate, var_score_cutoff))
benchmark_cutoffs <- tibble(SCORE  = "PHENOTYPE SCORE",
                            CUTOFF = pheno_score_cutoff_benchmark)
```

## Plot

```{r plot, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 8}
scores_pheno_var_violin_plot <- ggplot(scores_long, aes(x = GROUP, y = VALUE, color = GROUP)) +
  sm_violin(points = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  facet_wrap(~ SCORE) +
  geom_hline(data = candidate_cutoffs, aes(yintercept = CUTOFF),
             colour = colorBlindGrey8[[4]], linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(data = benchmark_cutoffs, aes(yintercept = CUTOFF),
             colour = "gray", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "GROUP OF GENES", y = "EXOMISER SCORE") +
  theme(strip.text       = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"))

scores_pheno_var_violin_plot
```

## Save

```{r save}
out_name <- paste0("Exomiser_scores_violin_plot", file_suffix)

ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, paste0(out_name, ".tiff")), scores_pheno_var_violin_plot,
       width = 8, height = 8, device = "tiff", dpi = 700)
save(scores_pheno_var_violin_plot, file = file.path(images_dir, paste0(out_name, ".RData")))
```
